stem.text: A two-source interference experiment uses the apparatus shown.

stem.alt: Apparatus diagram from left to right: a lamp, a single slit, a double slit and a screen, with labels lamp, single slit, double slit and screen.

stem.text: What is the main purpose of the single slit?

A.text: to make a narrow beam of light

B.text: to make the same amplitude of light incident on each slit
